integrity: Standalone finite exhaustive programs reproduce the recorded small-order values and independent six-orbit certificates. General q >= 49 relies on the exact character expansion and the standard Hasse bound. Review is not an independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite Paley graphs with prime-power orders q >= 29, q congruent to 1 mod 4; induced vertex deletions; counting-free FO with at most four variable names and pure adjacency. No larger-deletion, other graph families or full FO claim. The 1993 primary paper on Paley adjacency property could only be inspected in abstract, and unlocated stronger historical coverage remains a priority risk.
title: Universal pair-deletion fragility and the four-variable Paley cutoff
